Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Accuracy of the automated means - Accuracy
Contextual Information:
The figures for accuracy are calculated by the sum of true positive matches and true negative matches, as a percentage of the total pieces of content removed during the applicable period. The accuracy score reflects the total number of true positive matches, meaning if one piece of content matches two tools, it will be reflected twice.

A true positive result is defined as a match to content which was then removed after visual review, as a human moderator determined the match was accurate. A true negative result is defined as the content removed during the relevant period which did not result in a tool match and was correctly assessed by the tool, as determined after visual review by a human moderator.

Section: Use of automated means for content moderation
Indicator: Accuracy of the automated means - Precision
Contextual Information:
The figures for precision are calculated by the number of true positives as a percentage of all matches. The precision score reflects the total number of true positive matches, meaning if one piece of content matches two tools, it will be reflected twice.

A true positive result is defined as a match to content which was then removed after visual review, as a human moderator determined the match was accurate. A false positive result is defined as a match which was overturned and deemed incorrect after review by a human moderator.
